title: Fill the two missing rows of M.43's pre-registered equal-level rescan: the detector and density-regression knobs, on the same 182 ShanghaiTech-A images, whole-image (no tiling)
why: M.43 reports "not measured, with no proxy substituted" for the detector and density-regression knobs because their weights were not on the serving machine. Both are two of the design's own six-knob list (F.2). Filling them turns the ordering claim from a 4/6 test into a 6/6 test, and gives F.2's detector row (30.0-90.0 pp) and density row (20.1-34.3 pp) their first independent rescan values. Upstream decision 2026-10-02: the tiling protocol is WHOLE IMAGE (no 2x2 tiling).
machine: A800 (single card for both halves; neither half needs a vLLM serving session)
supersedes: none; this is a new probe. It CHANGES NO PRINTED NUMBER by itself - the two new rows are reported as measured, outside the same-session block of M.43 (see caliber_red_lines).

pool.images: the same 182 ShanghaiTech-A test images used by M.43's four-knob rescan
pool.gt: ShanghaiTech-A test point counts (gt per image)

estimator.per_level: dev(level) = 100 * (sum(pred) - sum(gt)) / sum(gt), over the level's PAIRED ITEM INTERSECTION
estimator.span: max(dev over the five levels) - min(dev over the five levels)
estimator.eligibility: >=3 levels and >=20 common items (the A39 rule, not relaxed)
estimator.ordering_statistic: Spearman rank correlation over knob spans

detector.axis: threshold tau x input size, WHOLE IMAGE (no tiling)
detector.instrument: ultralytics YOLO11n, COCO-pretrained (zero-shot), topk = 300 raw detections kept per image
detector.why_yolo11n: it is the dense-end instrument this paper's own E5 data already uses (analysis/data/E5_data/det_st_a_test_yolo11n_whole.csv: 182 st_a items, whole image, tau columns 0.05..0.9, n_raw capped at 300)

primary_levels.definition: five input sizes (short-side-independent: imgsz is passed to the detector directly), tau FIXED at 0.25
primary_levels.rule_stated_before_the_run: five log-spaced sizes bracketing the native 1024; tau fixed at the midpoint of the paper's own tau grid (0.05..0.9)

secondary_reported_not_adjudicated: the tau-only ladder at the native size, which is directly comparable to the existing E5 st_a file
detector.abort: if fewer than 178 of the 182 images produce a detection run, mark THAT LEVEL not evaluable and report the count; never pad

density.instrument: OFFICIAL DM-Count, model_sh_A.pth (the in-domain official weight for ShanghaiTech-A)

primary_levels.definition: protocol = mult, value in {0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5} (the five smallest of the six multipliers present in the existing CSRNet/st_a ladder; dropping the largest 2.0 is a construction rule fixed before seeing any span)

cross_caliber.instrument: CSRNet / st_a, already on disk (analysis/data/pod_mirror/A/csrsta_ladder_st_a.csv, 182 items x 10 levels)
cross_caliber.role: zero-new-call cross-check; the two calibers must agree in DIRECTION and be same-order-of-magnitude. If they disagree, report 'caliber-dependent' and do not pick one.

density.abort: if the resize convention cannot be shown to reproduce the existing CSRNet ladder's recorded in_w/in_h, STOP (the ruler would not be the same ruler)

G0_selfcheck_m43.statement: the shared estimator must reproduce M.43's four printed rows LEVEL BY LEVEL: output contract 343.55 (-54.4/+72.0/+107.1/-98.5/+245.1), prompt family 1561.94, tiling 14.56, pixel budget 31.65
G0_selfcheck_m43.abort: if it does not reproduce, the estimator or the record set differs from the printed one -> STOP, do not run anything else, report which level mismatched
G0_selfcheck_m43.note: M.43's reproduction sentence names NO file. The four record files / analyser could not be located in the released tree by name (searched m43 / equal_level / rescan / rung / lvl / content 343.55 / 1561.94). Open item: fill p2e/m43_records.json with the four paths, or release them (v0629 candidate).

G1_protocol_conformance.statement: the resize convention used for the density half reproduces csrsta_ladder_st_a.csv's recorded in_w/in_h for every (item, protocol, value) within +/-1 px, or exactly for at least 99% of rows

criteria.statement: every level has all 182 items present in the per-item output; checked per level, not sampled
report the detector five-level span and its five level values
criteria.dual_direction: same sign and same order of magnitude as F.2's printed 30.0-90.0 pp; if it is not, report the measured value and say the independent rescan disagrees with the published row - direction is not chosen by preference

criteria.statement: report the official-DM-Count five-level span and its five level values
criteria.dual_direction: the primary row is the UNCALIBRATED pooled span, exactly like M.43's other four rows; it enters the six-knob ordering. F.2's printed density row (20.1-34.3 pp) is ISOTONIC-CALIBRATED (F.9 splits knobs into (knob x domain) units and reports them calibrated), so it is NOT directly comparable to an uncalibrated pooled span - comparing them is a caliber mismatch. Report the calibrated variant as a secondary reading and state the caliber explicitly; do not assert a pass/fail on the F.2 band from the uncalibrated number
criteria.observed_warning_20261002: the CSRNet/st_a cross-check caliber, five mult levels {0.5,0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5}, uncalibrated: devs [-67.07, -6.90, +103.78, +301.85, +601.85], span 668.92 pp. That is ~20x F.2's calibrated band, which is exactly the caliber mismatch this criterion warns about - and it also shows CSRNet is strongly scale-sensitive at mult>=1.25, so the DM-Count ladder may be a large-span knob. Both are reportable; neither is chosen by preference.

criteria.statement: the CSRNet/st_a caliber (zero new calls) and the official-DM-Count caliber must agree in DIRECTION; same order of magnitude is reported but not required for a pass
criteria.abort: if they disagree in direction, report 'caliber-dependent' and do not pick one

criteria.statement: with the two new rows added, the six-knob ascending ordering is compared with the published one (F.2 / M.37 per-unit medians): report the Spearman and which knobs swap
criteria.note: M.43's four-knob rescan already reports a swap at the bottom (Spearman 0.800); the six-knob value is the new quantity

caliber_red_lines: The two new rows are NOT from the same serving session as M.43's four rows. They must be labelled as such wherever they are used, and M.43's 3.01 pp same-session noise floor must NOT be borrowed across sessions to argue about them.
No proxy is substituted. If a knob cannot be driven, it stays 'not measured'.
The density row is titled with its caliber ('official DM-Count' or 'CSRNet'). Appendix D.1 requires official and reproduction weights to be reported separately.
Whole image only (upstream decision 2026-10-02). No 2x2 tiling in the primary reading; a tiled variant, if ever run, is a separate stratum and is never pooled with this one.

outputs.detector_ladder: out/p2e_detector_ladder.csv  (item,weights,tau,imgsz,gt,n_det,n_det_person) - same columns as the existing VisDrone ladder
outputs.density_ladder: out/p2e_density_ladder.csv  (item,dataset,protocol,value,gt,in_w,in_h,in_px,px_per_obj,pred) - same columns as the existing CSRNet ladder
outputs.release: instrument scripts + weights manifest (sha256) + the two ladder CSVs + this criteria file (md5 frozen) + the analyser

machine_discipline: fetch every artefact back and md5-verify before releasing it
do not start while another session's job holds the card; that side's handover note says it starts its backlog only after we say we are done
